mission: Adjudicate the 4 preserved contact disputes from D2-05 using the D2-05 method (independent re-derivation + documented criteria), producing versioned append-only adjudication records that reference what they adjudicate, and resolve the camera-cut inconsistency finding.

source.license: Public domain (U.S. federal government work, PD-USGov; DVIDS)

provenance.frameExtraction: ffmpeg select=eq(n,IDX) absolute CFR indexing; source frames 808-840, 888-906, 985-1004 extracted to /tmp only; no media committed; media re-downloaded from the registered rights-cleared DVIDS source and hash-verified.
provenance.derivationTooling: Connected-component green-pixel ball candidate detection ((G>150) AND (G>R+20) AND (G>B+60), scipy.ndimage.label, blobs >=8px, static scene blobs excluded) used to locate candidates across frames; every adjudication-critical frame confirmed by eye on the full frame or a 240px crop. Camera cut measured by mean absolute grayscale difference between adjacent source frames.

adjudicationMethod: Third independent pass, blind to preferring either side: ball positions re-derived per source frame, contact defined as ball-at-paddle adjacency or ball direction reversal across adjacent frames; verdicts compare BOTH the prior label and the D2-05 audit value against the re-derived track. Predictions never relabeled as observations; originals never rewritten.

verdicts.keyEvidence: No ball within 600-700px of the target's paddle in either the prior bracket (1083-1150ms) or the audit window (1201-1235ms). Incoming fast ball first visible src814 (65,412), ~90px/frame rightward, reaches the paddle only at src824-826 ((830,576)@825 at paddle face, departing (740,546)@826) = clip 1468-1568ms across offsets 779-780, the span already covered by the undisputed 1484 event. The audit's 1218 reversal is not reproducible.

At prior time (src ~830.5-831.5) the struck ball is mid-return leftward ((341,477)@830 -> (106,479)@832, no paddle near, no direction change) and a SECOND concurrent ball is post-floor-bounce (bounce src827, y-max 797) rising toward the partner ((613,729)@830 -> (672,706)@833), first touched at the undisputed 1934 partner dig (src836-838; audit inbound (752,717) matches this track's (752,719)@837). New forensic mechanism: two distinct balls; the 1934 dig plays a different ball than the target's src824-826 contact.

Hard cut measured between source frames 895/896: mean abs grayscale diff 54.15 vs baseline 1.71-3.07 over src888-906 (~18x spike); framing changes from close front-oblique to wide multi-court. Prior contact time 3870ms = clip n115.98, the cut boundary itself; no contact observable from either side.

Re-derived track src987-998 is a single smooth ballistic arc ((920,178)@987 -> (1237,219)@996 -> (1323,259)@998), x monotone, no direction change at prior time src ~995.5; ball visually above/behind the gray-shirt man with no paddle-ball adjacency. Prior note itself marks the contact as interpolated.

cameraCutResolution.finding: D2-05 flagged: 'registry describes rally1 as a single continuous shot, but a cut exists at clip ~3.85s'.
cameraCutResolution.resolution: CONFIRMED BY MEASUREMENT. datasets/corpus/recordings.json rec-21fb75446a03 (afn-sasebo-rally1, trim 26.0-30.4s of rec-6e06a3157947) declares 'Single continuous shot' with evidence 'declared', but a hard cut exists between source frames 895 and 896 (source 29.86-29.90s, inside the declared trim; clip ~3.85-3.90s): mean abs grayscale diff 54.15 vs 1.71-3.07 baseline over src888-906, with visually different camera framing on each side. The rally1 clip therefore contains TWO shots; its final ~0.5s (clip frames >= n116 at offset 780) is a different camera.
cameraCutResolution.registryCorrectionRecommended: Change rec-21fb75446a03 derivedFrom detail from 'Single continuous shot' to note the shot boundary at source frame 895/896 (~29.87s), and record evidence 'measured (mean-abs-frame-diff spike + visual confirmation, wave-f f13)'. recordings.json is integrator-owned and was intentionally NOT modified by this workstream.
cameraCutResolution.downstreamImplication: The rally1 3870 event (eventStart 3500, eventEnd 4300) spans the cut and cannot be certified from this clip; rally2 (trim 30.6-36.0s) lies entirely after the cut and is a single shot as declared.

datasetScope: Bundles afn-sasebo-rally1 and afn-sasebo-rally2 only (both derived from the single source recording dvids-967848; evaluation grouping by source session is therefore trivially satisfied). Held-out cases wm-dink-01 and afn-vic-rally1 and the fresh-candidates pool untouched.

newForensicFindings: Two concurrent balls in afn-sasebo-rally1 during 1100-1950ms: the ball dug by the partner at 1934 (slow arc, floor bounce at src827) is distinct from the ball the target struck at src824-826; this explains both the 1117 and 1717 phantom labels.
The D2-05 audit's replacement value 1218 for the 1117 dispute is not reproducible by a third pass and should not be adopted; the dispute resolves to no-contact-in-window, not to a shifted contact.
Camera cut localized to an exact source-frame boundary (895/896) with quantified evidence, upgrading the D2-05 'declared vs observed' inconsistency to a measured registry error.

constraints.mediaDownloadedMB: ~65 (local only, gitignored path, rights-cleared PD-USGov source already registered in datasets/corpus/sources.json, sha256 re-verified)

honesty.originalsUntouched: Prior annotation files and D2-05 audit sidecars are byte-identical; adjudications are new append-only sidecar files that reference what they adjudicate.
honesty.predictionsVsObservations: All evidence derives from direct frame re-derivation of the source media; no model predictions used; no interpolation reported as observation.
honesty.provenNegatives: Three of four verdicts are proven negatives (no contact / not observable), reported as such rather than substituting fabricated contact times.
